description: Engine §4.1: removing an empty child prevents its rule name from giving an erased working view the X tag.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution fewest #·zz
%rule text $x:e A
%conditions $x ≇ #·e<X>
%rule w e
%rule g :: ($ ≅ #(⋮ b) ⟹ X)
  | A
%conditions $ ≇ #·⁅ ⋯ B ⁆
%rule e :: ($ ≅ #⁅ a ⁆ ⟹ X)
  | a :: P | b
%erased
%rule a ε | A
%rule b B
%rule zz Z Z Z
